name: branding-lavender-mug-with-serif-message-contact-slide
title: Lavender Mug Contact Slide
whatItIs: A lavender gradient slide with a white mug printed in navy serif 'A gentle reminder to enjoy your day!' floating at right, dashed curves and dots around it, and a white 'Get in touch!' call to action bottom left.
whatItMeans: A branded mug turns a contact slide into a warm, tactile moment, and the gentle serif keeps the tone kind.
techniques: Product object as a sign-off hero
Navy serif text on white ceramic
Dashed curved lines threading the scene
Lavender gradient deepening at the base

vocabulary.definition: A branded everyday object shown as a product.
A dashed line that guides the eye across a slide.
A call to action set in italic serif type.
